summary: Medtronic plc, the Irish-domiciled medical-device issuer, filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 dated September 17, 2026, referencing an event of September 14, 2026. The excerpt lists the registrant's NYSE-listed ordinary shares and numerous euro-denominated senior notes, a standard debt-registration disclosure, with no special-situation transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing condition disclosed. No deal mechanics, regulatory clock, or overhang arise; the notice is a routine current report and warrants no risk-arbitrage attention.
